messages:
maria: heads up — i'm seeing a bunch of traces for /api/v1/orders that stop at the edge service. the background writer/worker spans never show up. noticed in prod only. anyone seen this pattern before? :thinking:

jon: hm. do you mean the job that consumes the kafka topic or the internal background task in the edge container?

maria: the async worker that processes the write events (kafka -> db). traces show the request span and then nothing. request id propagated in logs though.

ravi: first checks: which OTEL SDK are you using on the worker? python auto-instrumentation or our node/Go lib? also what's the sampler config?

maria: worker is python 3.10, we use opentelemetry-auto-instrumentation with otlp exporter to our collector. sampler is default, i think. sampling rate set by ENV OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER = parentbased_traceidratio? not sure.

ashley: can you paste the worker startup env and the header usage in the producer? common failure is traceparent header getting dropped at the kafka producer or when the worker deserializes context.

maria: here's the relevant bits from the worker Dockerfile/CMD: ```
ENV OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://collector.internal:4317
ENV OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio
ENV OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.02
python -m opentelemetry.instrumentation.auto_instrument 
  --service-name=order-writer app.py
```

ravi: ok that looks like traceidratio 2% on the worker — if the request had sampled==false, the worker won't create child spans. are the edge spans sampled? check a few full traces for sampled=true.

maria: i pulled two full traces where edge span sampled=true, but still no downstream spans. the request has traceparent header on the HTTP side. kafka producer code sets headers: {"traceparent": traceparent}.

jon: Kafka can drop headers if you're using the Java producer with old serializers or if the message goes through a connect transform. Also the python consumer lib might not auto-extract by default from message headers.

ashley: try extracting context manually in the worker before creating the tracer scope. quick snippet: ```python
from opentelemetry.trace.propagation.tracecontext import TraceContextTextMapPropagator
ctx = TraceContextTextMapPropagator().extract(carrier=message.headers)
with tracer.start_as_current_span('process_order', context=ctx):
    ...
```

maria: good call. i also remembered we have a small helper layer that converts kafka headers list into dict; might be mapping keys to bytes and the propagator expects str.

ravi: another angle: collector sampling rules. our collector has tail-sampling rule for high-payload traces and a sampling override for trace name /api/v1/orders. if the collector drops the child spans before sending to backend you'll see edge only. check the collector logs and the sampling config: https://dashboards.internal/collector/sampling (you should have read access).

obs-bot: deploy notice: any changes to sampling or tracing libs will trigger a minor deploy cadence check per obs playbook. See https://playbook.internal/observability/tracing for steps. :warning:

maria: i checked collector config — there is a tail-sample policy that keeps 1% of traces for that service unless sampled upstream. might explain it. but i still think header propagation failure is possible.

jon: quick way to validate: emit a tiny test message from edge with traceparent, then in the worker log the extracted span context before starting spans. something like: ```python
ctx = propagator.extract(...)
print('trace id', format(trace.get_current_span(ctx).get_span_context().trace_id, '032x'))
```

maria: will try that. also, where's the dashboard to look at request-level tracing for order-writes? i couldn't find the specific view.

ravi: use the traces explorer: https://dashboards.internal/traces/explorer?service=edge-service&span=process_order and filter by trace id or request path. for metrics, check: https://dashboards.internal/metrics/requests?service=edge-service&route=/api/v1/orders

maria: thanks — those links helped. i spun up a local consumer, reproduced with a test header and verified extraction fails because headers arrive as bytes and our helper doesn't decode. patch incoming.

ashley: nice! once patched, let's also adjust the sampler temporarily to 20% for that route so we can get more end-to-end traces while we confirm. open a PR and @ravi will approve the sampler tweak. :thumbsup:

maria: created PR #4321 — sampler env change and header decode fix. cc @ravi for quick review.

ravi: looking. one more ask: once fixed, please run a quick sweep of recent 5xx alerts — sometimes missing spans correlate with retries that hide errors. if noise increases, we'll tune the 5xx alert to use rate over 5m instead of 1m.

maria: noted. i'll also attach a small repro script and the sample trace ids in the PR.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for order-writer staging after CI passes. ETA ~12m.

maria: staging verification passed, end-to-end spans now visible in traces explorer. closing loop, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
